messages.subject: textInput width fill column
parts:
Hi guys,

I'm trying to get something really simple working. I've set up a ui.R file with fluidRows like this:

shinyUI(fluidPage(theme = "bootstrap.css",
   fluidRow(
      column(8, align="center", offset = 2,
         textInput("string", label="",value = ""),
         tags$style(type="text/css", "#string { height: 50px; width: 100%; text-align:center; font-size: 30px; margin-top:100%;}")
      )
   ),
  
   fluidRow(
      column(6, align="center", offset = 3,
         actionButton("button",label = textOutput("prediction")),
         tags$style(type='text/css', "#button { height: 50px; width: 100%; font-size: 30px;}")
      )
   )
)
)

I want the textInput object to fill the full space (and be centered) of the column that I created. I specify in the style tag that the width should be 100% but it doesn't do anything. I've got the exact same style tag for a button and that works fine.

What am I missing here?

Thanks in advance.

messages.subject: Re: textInput width fill column
parts: You can "Inspect the element"  if you are using Google Chrome, Then you will see which css file decide its style.
